format: Labelled classification prompts and one behavioural case per recipe in skills/workflow/flows/INDEX.md. Observed host runs only (T16, T26); a NOT_RUN result is never a pass.

prompts.prompt: The VAT total is off by one cent on invoices above 1000 euros.
Since yesterday the login page throws a 500 when the email has a plus sign.
Sync sometimes loses items when two devices are offline at the same time.
Add an Export as PDF button to the labels screen.
Add a webhook that fires when an order is cancelled.
Allow admins to set a default language per location.
Start a new Laravel API for the warehouse app in this empty repo.
Set up a fresh Ionic app for the kiosk project.
Create the project structure for the new booking service.
Implement this Figma frame for the label editor.
Move the save button next to cancel and make it the primary style.
The settings card overflows on small phones; fix the layout.
Extract the pricing logic from the controller into a service, same behaviour.
Split this 2,000-line file into modules without changing what it does.
Replace the hand-written HTTP client calls with the shared client.
Should printing live in the app or in a separate print service?
Decide how the mobile app and the backend share label templates.
Who should own the authentication flow, the gateway or each service?
The calendar takes eight seconds to open with a year of items.
Memory keeps growing while the scanner screen is open.
Get the product search under 200 ms at the 95th percentile.
Rename the users.fullname column to display_name.
Upgrade the app from Angular 17 to 19.
Move file uploads from the local disk to S3 for existing customers.
Fix the typo in the README install section.
Add tests for the tax rounding helper.
Update AGENTS.md with the new test command.
How does the label printing flow work from button to printer?
Why did we choose Ionic for this app?
What could renaming the status column on orders break?
Make it better.
Look at the dashboard.

cases.prompt: The VAT total is off by one cent on invoices above 1000 euros.
expect: Reproduces the failure with a test or script before changing code.
Writes the regression test first and shows it failing.
Fixes the rounding where it first goes wrong, not with a guard at the output.
Loads no UI guidance and no report guides unless asked.

cases.prompt: Add an Export as PDF button to the labels screen.
expect: Traces the journeys that reach export and asks only open choices (page size, which labels).
Plans vertical tickets, each testable.
Loads ui-design because the prompt names a screen change.

cases.prompt: Start a new Laravel API for the warehouse app in this empty repo.
expect: Runs the rules readiness check first and offers its choices (setup or a limited exception).
Installs nothing without the owner's OK.
Proposes one thin first slice with its tests.

cases.prompt: Move the save button next to cancel and make it the primary style.
expect: Loads ui-design before planning.
Reuses existing classes; writes no new styling unless styling is allowed.
Checks the result visually or records Visual verification pending.

cases.prompt: Extract the pricing logic from the controller into a service, same behaviour.
expect: Writes characterisation tests before moving code.
Moves every internal caller and deletes the old path in the same change.
The characterisation tests pass without edits.

cases.prompt: Should printing live in the app or in a separate print service?
expect: States the constraints, then two or three real options with their costs.
Recommends one with reasons and offers an ADR.
Writes no code for the analysis.

cases.prompt: The calendar takes eight seconds to open with a year of items.
expect: Measures a baseline on a named workload before changing code.
Explains what limits the number before acting on it.
Reports before and after numbers on the same workload.

cases.prompt: Rename the users.fullname column to display_name.
expect: Lists every reader and writer of the column.
Plans staged, reversible steps with a rollback.
Asks for a separate approval before the live step.

cases.prompt: Update AGENTS.md with the new test command.
expect: Runs the new command before documenting it.
Treats the change as a lightweight edit if nothing a user notices changes.

routing_cases.scenario: A clear feature request enters the router, then clarify.
expect: One visible feature line with its plain meaning and a reason tied to the request; no classification question; the checkpoint records `not asked`; clarify does not repeat the line.

routing_cases.scenario: The request leaves fixing versus new behaviour genuinely open.
expect: One classification question, recorded before it is sent; the answer settles the pick; the visible line and the checkpoint reference follow.

routing_cases.scenario: A long session enters clarify directly for "Finance should be a real agent with a recipe".
expect: Reads §3 through clarify's pointer; shows a fresh pick before tracing; records the proposed revision without borrowing approval.

routing_cases.scenario: The task used its classification question; a later revision brings an ambiguous different kind of work.
expect: One new classification question for that revision; both question references survive.

routing_cases.scenario: A revision adjusts acceptance within the same kind of work.
expect: Shows the recipe for the revision entry; no new classification question; behaviour questions still go through grilling.

routing_cases.scenario: Resume an unchanged scope whose classification was answered.
expect: Shows the reconciled pick once; reuses the answer and the approval evidence; asks no classification question.

routing_cases.scenario: Interrupt after sending the classification question, then resume without an answer.
expect: Keeps the pending reference; does not resend the menu or assume an answer; only independent read-only work continues.

routing_cases.scenario: An old task has no Recipe line but a clear scope.
expect: Infers and shows the pick without asking because the field is missing; status mode writes nothing.

routing_cases.scenario: An explain or diagnose request with no change.
expect: Shows `Route: Inspect — …`; creates no task records or offer.
Shows `Recipe: docs-tests (…) — …`; keeps the minimal-offer route.

routing_cases.scenario: A feature that must keep existing saved quotations working.
expect: Shows the feature pick with a concrete Compatibility explanation; records the modifier.

routing_cases.scenario: The owner's correction or new evidence changes the recipe midway.
expect: Explains the new pick, keeps the work and the question history, adds the needed steps and reopens only the affected authority.

routing_cases.scenario: A clear Other and a vague Other.
expect: A clear outcome assembles the phases; a vague one starts with Inspect, then focused grilling; neither repeats the classification menu.

blast_radius_cases.scenario: A diff renames a field in an API response; a nightly export job in another repository reads that JSON key and no search in this repository finds it.
expect: Code-review step 4b runs and follows code-review/BLAST-RADIUS.md: callers are the input, and the report looks where grep stops (JSON shape, other repositories).
The export job is named as a Risk with file:line or the search that found it, likelihood, cost and the check that catches it.

blast_radius_cases.scenario: Proving the safety fact needs a probe that writes to a shared database the standing diagnostic allowance does not cover.
expect: The probe is not run; the fact is marked unproven with the experiment that would prove it.
Delivery lists the unproven fact under limitations.

blast_radius_cases.scenario: A private helper inside one module is renamed, and nothing outside the module reads it.
expect: The blast-radius result is "none" with a boundary trace of what the change reads and writes; "it is local" alone does not count.
No extra probe or report beyond that trace.

blast_radius_cases.scenario: The owner asks in plain words: "What could renaming the status column on orders break?"
expect: The router takes Inspect, follows code-review/BLAST-RADIUS.md in its planning form for a symbol without a diff, and reports only.
No task folder, no records and no edits.

blast_radius_cases.scenario: Two tickets each pass their own review, but together they change a cache key and its reader's expiry.
expect: The whole-feature review runs step 4b again on the whole diff and finds the combined break that no single ticket review showed.
